context.body: Vision, confession, atonement, and commission unfold in rapid sequence.
context.label: Narrative or literary frame

observations.body: The Lord sits high on a throne, is acclaimed as holy, shakes the thresholds, cleanses Isaiah, and asks whom to send.
observations.label: The Holy One commissions Isaiah: action

observations.body: Isaiah confesses unclean lips, receives cleansing, hears the question, and volunteers.
observations.label: The Holy One commissions Isaiah: response

observations.body: holy, holy, holy · unclean lips · guilt taken away · send me
observations.label: Words in Isaiah 6:1–8

payload.posture: Read Isaiah 6:1–8 as the prophetic voice evidence before carrying it into another source.
payload.tension: The scene identifies the enthroned Lord while later Scripture’s use of the vision raises further questions about divine identity.
payload.title: The Holy One commissions Isaiah
